name: Stochastic 14 exit from the extremes
description: MEAN REVERSION. George Lane's oscillator, traded the way he described it in the 1950s: the entry is not the extreme itself but the return out of it - long when %K climbs back above 20, short when it falls back below 80. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: 14 periods with 3/3 smoothing and the 20/80 thresholds. BORN ON THE DAILY. Compared with rsi-mean-reversion it waits for the exit from the extreme instead of entering into it, which is the same hypothesis with a delay: on data where mean reversion works the delay costs entry price, and on data where it does not the delay avoids the worst fills.
